name: Spam Battle
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: A timed chat battle: chat spams the name of their favourite streamer, the overlay races the top names against each other with their share of the vote, and when the timer runs out it crowns the winner and loads their Twitch channel in a browser source on the live OBS scene.

settings.label: Battle timer
settings.description: The timer that runs each battle. One is made for you; pick another to use a timer you already have. How long a battle lasts when you start it without saying how long is set on the timer itself.

settings.label: Call to chat
settings.description: Said in chat and shown on the overlay when a battle starts.
settings.defaultValue: Spam your favorite streamer in chat!

settings.label: Prize
settings.description: Said in chat and shown on the overlay. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Only count partners and affiliates
settings.description: On: a name counts only if it is a Twitch partner or affiliate, so everyday chat words can't sneak onto the board. Off: any Twitch channel counts.

settings.label: Names that can't be voted for
settings.description: Channels to leave off the board, like your own channel or your bots. Separate names with commas. Messages from these accounts are ignored too.
settings.defaultValue: nightbot, streamelements, streamlabs, moobot, fossabot, sery_bot, wizebot, soundalerts

settings.label: Show the winner's channel in OBS
settings.description: After the winner is crowned, load their Twitch channel in a browser source on your live scene. Needs the OBS module.

settings.label: Browser source name
settings.description: The browser source to use. It's added to your live scene the first time, then reused.

settings.label: Seconds to celebrate before OBS
settings.description: How long the winner celebration plays before their channel loads.

actions.name: Count Spam Battle votes
actions.description: Counts the streamer a chat message names while a battle is on, and lets moderators run battles with !spambattle. The module's own workflow runs this on every chat message.

fields.description: The channel this message voted for, or empty.

actions.name: Start a Spam Battle
actions.description: Starts a new battle, replacing one already running, and tells chat what to do.

schema.label: Seconds
schema.description: Leave empty to use the timer's own length.

actions.name: End the Spam Battle now
actions.description: Stops the clock and crowns whoever is ahead.

fields.description: Empty when nobody got a vote.

actions.name: Cancel the Spam Battle
actions.description: Stops the battle without a winner and clears it from the overlay.

actions.name: Show the Spam Battle winner in OBS
actions.description: Loads the last winner's Twitch channel in the browser source named in the settings, on the live scene. Runs by itself after a battle when the setting is on.

fields.description: The page loaded, or empty when there is no winner.

actions.name: Follow the Spam Battle timer
actions.description: Starts a battle when its timer is started from anywhere, and crowns the winner when it runs out. The module's own workflows run this on every timer change.

fields.description: Whether the change was to the battle timer.

triggers.name: Spam Battle started
triggers.description: Fires when a Spam Battle opens for votes.

triggers.name: Spam Battle ended
triggers.description: Fires when a Spam Battle's time is up, or a moderator ends it, with the winner.

fields.description: False when nobody got a vote.
The winner's share of all votes, 0 to 100.

deadlines.description: Loads the winner's channel in OBS once the celebration has played.

widgets.name: Spam Battle
widgets.description: The top names racing head to head with their share of the vote and the clock, then a big winner reveal. Hidden while no battle is on.

settingsSchema.label: Seconds to show the winner
settingsSchema.description: 0 keeps the winner up until the next battle.
